Line numbering

ETCSL composite numbering (the Agade Ur III segments as "Ver.2, Seg.X, N"). Related: ../../ETCSL/2.1.5--*/.

Usefulness

Rank 2 lexical/morphological aid (ḫamṭu/marû, prefix chain, Emesal ↔ main-dialect lemma) for קינות-על-ערים/2-קללת-אכד/. Note: ePSD2 lemmatises the Emesal verb ga (Lament for Ur 1–34) as ga[carry], ETCSL as de₆ "carry" (the main-dialect equivalent); they agree on the sense.
